Questions

Is Orbit free?

Yes. Track up to three habits free forever. Orbit Plus unlocks unlimited habits and buddies.

Does it work offline?

Completely. Sync happens quietly the next time you are online.

Can I export my data?

Any time, as a CSV file, from Settings.
